# Torn Training Optimizer (Torn Gym Calculator)

> A free, privacy-first web app that helps players of the online game Torn (torn.com)
> optimize gym training. Also known as a Torn gym calculator / gym gains calculator /
> happy jump calculator. It reads a player's stats, gym dots and perks via the official
> Torn API and computes, for each battle stat, the best gym to use, the optimal training
> method, the cheapest energy plan, what it costs to unlock the next gym, and a multi-day
> stat projection — using the game's validated gym-gain formula.

Website: https://torntraining.com

## Pages
- https://torntraining.com/ — the calculator itself (API key or manual stats)
- https://torntraining.com/guide/ — full gym training guide (happy, energy, drugs, gyms; verified)
- https://torntraining.com/happy-jump/ — happy jump calculator & guide (recipe + jump-vs-energy break-even)
- https://torntraining.com/specialist-gyms/ — specialist gym requirements (exact ratios, dots)
- https://torntraining.com/stat-cap/ — the 50M stat cap: removed in 2022, and the curve that replaced it
- https://torntraining.com/gym-dots/ — complete gym dots chart (all gyms, all four battle stats)
- https://torntraining.com/gyms/ — index of all 32 gyms, one detail page each (/gyms/<slug>/)
- https://torntraining.com/gym-unlock-order/ — the 24 standard gyms in unlock order, with costs
- https://torntraining.com/best-gym-for-{strength,defense,speed,dexterity}/ — gyms ranked by dots per stat
- https://torntraining.com/training-ratios/ — how stat ratios gate the specialist gyms
- https://torntraining.com/xanax-vs-lsd/ — why the shared drug cooldown decides the answer

## What it does
- Optimal training plan per battle stat (Strength, Defense, Speed, Dexterity): it picks
  the method by stat level — happy jumps win at low stats, but plain energy training wins
  once stats are high (stacking energy for a jump wastes regeneration), so it does not tell
  high-stat players to chase 99k happy jumps.
- Auto-detects the player's gym-gain modifier (M) per stat from their perks, with a breakdown.
- Best gym a player can actually use per stat, respecting unlocked gyms (gym EXP) and the
  specialist-gym requirements (Balboas, Frontline, Mr. Isoyamas, The Elites, Sports Science Lab, etc.).
- Economics: cheapest energy by $/energy and a daily energy capacity view that accounts for
  the shared drug cooldown — so it does not call LSD "cheaper" when Xanax gives 5x the energy
  per cooldown slot.
- Budget optimizer: the best items to buy under a money budget for the most gains.
- Unlock planner: how much energy, money and days to unlock a specific gym or reach a target stat.
- Multi-day stat projection chart and progress tracking (snapshot stats over time, compare
  real gains to the formula's prediction).

## Key facts
- Free, no ads, not affiliated with Torn or Torn.com.
- The player's Torn API key stays in their browser and is only ever sent to api.torn.com.
  There is no server, no database and no account; nothing is stored remotely.
- Read-only; a Torn "Limited" access key is sufficient.
- Uses the standard Torn gym-gain (Vladar) formula, validated against real in-game trains to
  about 0.1%.
- Models the post-2022 stat curve. Torn removed the 50,000,000 gym stat cap on 02/08/2022; above it
  gains keep growing at a steadily decreasing rate. The effective stat used by the formula is
  S_eff = 50,000,000 + (S - 50,000,000) / (8.77635 * log10(S)), derived by inverting the monthly
  growth figures Torn published with the change and matching all of them from 1b to 1t within 0.5%.
  Calculators that still clamp at 50M under-predict end-game gains; this one does not.
- Gym-gain perks are compounded multiplicatively, M = product of (1 + perk), per the community
  reference formula — not summed.

## Related / similar tools
TornStats, YATA, Torn Tools. TornStats is a broad faction platform (spy logs, war hits, company
tracking) that requires an account. Torn Training Optimizer is narrower and focused specifically on
gym-training optimization, with a privacy-first (client-side, no server, no account) design, and it
models the post-2022 stat curve that most gym calculators still get wrong.
